checks.trait.checks.draconic_ancestry.de: A dragon bloodline you pick sets the damage type of your breath and the damage you resist.
checks.trait.checks.breath_weapon.desc: You can exhale a cone or line of elemental energy at nearby foes.
checks.trait.checks.damage_resistance.de: Your ancestry shields you from fire: fire and lava hurt you half as much.
checks.trait.checks.darkvision.desc: You can see in darkness as if it were dim light.
checks.trait.checks.draconic_flight.desc: Spectral wings break your fall: you take half damage from falling.
checks.trait.checks.dwarven_resilience.d: Poison has a hard time getting to you: advantage on the Constitution save against poison, wither and hunger.
checks.trait.checks.dwarven_toughness.de: You are sturdier than most: half a hit point more max health for each character level.
checks.trait.checks.stonecunning.desc: Touching stone lets you briefly sense tremors and hidden things through it.
checks.trait.checks.elven_lineage.desc: Your elven heritage grants you a little innate magic.
checks.trait.checks.fey_ancestry.desc: Magic that clouds the mind slides off you: advantage on the Wisdom save against darkness.
checks.trait.checks.keen_senses.desc: Your sharp senses train you in noticing, reading people or surviving the wild: pick Insight, Perception or Survival at creation.
checks.trait.checks.trance.desc: You rest through a light, aware meditation instead of sleep, so phantoms never hunt you.
checks.trait.checks.gnomish_cunning.desc: Your quick wits hold up well against the mind's dangers: advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.
checks.trait.checks.gnomish_lineage.desc: Your gnomish heritage lets you speak with animals: bees, wolves, polar bears, llamas and pandas never attack you.
checks.trait.checks.giant_ancestry.desc: A trace of giant blood: your hits knock foes back further.
checks.trait.checks.large_form.desc: Your towering build lets you reach half a block further.
checks.trait.checks.powerful_build.desc: You stand your ground: advantage on the Strength save against big knockback.
checks.trait.checks.brave.desc: Fear has a hard time taking hold of you: advantage on the Wisdom save against darkness.
You can slip through the space of creatures bigger than you.
checks.trait.checks.luck.desc: When a d20 comes up 1 on a check or save, you roll it again.
checks.trait.checks.naturally_stealthy.d: You slip out of sight easily: advantage on Stealth checks.
checks.trait.checks.resourceful.desc: Once a day, a check or save you fail is rolled again.
checks.trait.checks.skillful.desc: You pick up one extra skill of your choice at creation.
checks.trait.checks.versatile.desc: You learn an extra talent: one more skill of your choice at creation.
checks.trait.checks.adrenaline_rush.desc: You are quick on your feet: you move a little faster.
checks.trait.checks.relentless_endurance: Once a day, a blow that would drop you leaves you standing on 1 HP.
checks.trait.checks.fiendish_legacy.desc: A fiendish bloodline shields you from fire: fire and lava hurt you half as much.
checks.trait.checks.otherworldly_presenc: Something about you marks you as kin to the Nether: piglins never attack you.
checks.species.checks.dragonborn.desc: Proud folk descended from dragons, who carry their ancestors' breath and scales.
checks.species.checks.dwarf.desc: Stout, long-lived folk shaped by stone and forge, tough as the mountains they live in.
checks.species.checks.elf.desc: Graceful, long-lived people with a touch of fey magic and keen senses.
checks.species.checks.gnome.desc: Small, curious tinkerers whose sharp minds hold a spark of magic.
checks.species.checks.goliath.desc: Towering folk with the blood of giants running in their veins.
checks.species.checks.halfling.desc: Small, cheerful wanderers who are braver and luckier than they look.
checks.species.checks.human.desc: Adaptable and ambitious, found everywhere and good at a bit of everything.
checks.species.checks.orc.desc: Strong, enduring people who push through pain that would stop others.
checks.species.checks.tiefling.desc: People touched by the lower planes, marked by a fiendish legacy and innate magic.
checks.background.checks.acolyte.desc: You served at a temple, learning its rites and the ways of the faithful.
checks.background.checks.criminal.desc: You made your living on the wrong side of the law, quiet and quick-fingered.
checks.background.checks.sage.desc: You spent years among books and scrolls, chasing knowledge for its own sake.
checks.background.checks.soldier.desc: You trained for war and know the drill, the march and the fight.
checks.background.checks.miner.desc: You worked the deep tunnels, listening for danger in the dark.
checks.background.checks.farmer.desc: You raised crops and animals, and know the land and its seasons.
checks.background.checks.explorer.desc: You roamed far from home, mapping wild places and searching old ruins.
checks.background.checks.smith.desc: You worked a forge, shaping metal and trading what you made.
checks.class.checks.barbarian.desc: A fierce warrior who fights with primal rage.
checks.class.checks.bard.desc: A performer whose words and music carry real magic.
checks.class.checks.cleric.desc: A servant of the divine who channels holy power.
checks.class.checks.druid.desc: A keeper of the wild who draws magic from nature itself.
checks.class.checks.fighter.desc: A master of weapons and armour, trained for any battle.
checks.class.checks.monk.desc: A disciplined martial artist who turns inner focus into speed and strikes.
checks.class.checks.paladin.desc: A holy warrior bound by a sacred oath.
checks.class.checks.ranger.desc: A hunter and scout at home in the wilderness.
checks.class.checks.rogue.desc: A sly expert in stealth, tricks and well-placed strikes.
checks.class.checks.sorcerer.desc: A spellcaster whose magic comes from within, by birth or by accident.
checks.class.checks.warlock.desc: A caster who gained magic through a pact with a powerful patron.
checks.class.checks.wizard.desc: A scholar of magic who learns spells through study.

commands.checks.help.unknown: No /checks command '%s' that you can use
commands.checks.help.get.description: Shows an entity's scores, proficiency, saves and skills.
commands.checks.help.get.details: Shows the target's six ability scores and modifiers, proficiency bonus, saving throws and every skill with its passive score, bonus sources included as on the stat screen. Name an ability or skill to show only that one. Works on any living entity.
commands.checks.help.set.description: Sets a player's ability score, skill bonus or proficiency bonus.
commands.checks.help.set.details: Sets and saves an ability score (1 to 30), a flat skill bonus (-30 to 30) or the proficiency bonus (0 to 10). It overrides the character, profiles and level.
commands.checks.help.prof.description: Sets a player's skill or saving throw proficiency.
commands.checks.help.prof.details: Sets and saves how proficient a player is in a skill, or in a saving throw when you name an ability. Saving throws can't have expertise.
commands.checks.help.roll.description: Rolls a check through Critfall, optionally against a DC.
commands.checks.help.roll.details: Rolls d20 plus the target's modifier for that ability or skill and prints the roll. With a DC it also says whether the check succeeds; meeting the DC succeeds.
commands.checks.help.check.description: Rolls a check against a DC for datapacks: 1 on success, fails otherwise.
commands.checks.help.check.details: Rolls d20 plus the target's modifier and bonus sources against the DC, firing check events. A success returns 1; a failure fails the command, so execute store result and store success both record 1 or 0.
commands.checks.help.check.example: /execute store success score @s sneaked run checks check @s stealth 15
commands.checks.help.reset.description: Clears a player's character, level and XP.
commands.checks.help.reset.details: Clears the player's character, dice rolls included, along with their level, XP and ability score improvements. Character creation opens again on their next join. Values set with /checks set stay.
commands.checks.help.level.details: Sets the level (1 to 20). Raising it counts as a level-up for each level gained, with the chat message and any ability score improvements. Refused while levelling is off.
commands.checks.help.xp.details: Adds character XP (at least 1) and levels the player up as they pass each threshold. Refused while levelling is off.
commands.checks.help.help.description: Lists the /checks commands you can use.
commands.checks.help.help.details: Without a command, lists every /checks command you have permission for. Name one to see more about it and an example.
commands.checks.error.no_scores: That entity has no ability scores
commands.checks.error.unknown_proficienc: Unknown proficiency '%s', expected none, proficient or expertise

checks.skill.checks.persuasion.use: In this mod: haggle with villagers and wandering traders for better prices, plead your way out of an alarm, or calm angry wolves, bees, endermen, zombified piglins and iron golems.
checks.skill.checks.deception.use: In this mod: lie to traders for better prices, talk your way out of an alarm, or convince piglins you're one of them.
checks.skill.checks.intimidation.use: In this mod: scare villagers and piglins into handing something over, or send weaker hostile mobs running.
checks.skill.checks.sleight_of_hand.use: In this mod: pick villagers' pockets, with advantage from behind, and disarm armed tripwires by sneaking and using them with an empty hand.
checks.skill.checks.athletics.use: In this mod: a sprinting jump over a drop of 3 or more blocks rolls Athletics to leap further, a cobweb rolls it to tear free, and a positive modifier climbs ladders and vines faster.
checks.skill.checks.acrobatics.use: In this mod: a fall that hurts rolls Acrobatics, harder the further you fall; make it and you land softer.
checks.skill.checks.stealth.use: In this mod: while you sneak, mobs whose passive Perception your passive Stealth beats notice you from closer.
checks.skill.checks.perception.use: In this mod: a high enough passive Perception makes armed tripwires near you glint; villagers use theirs to catch pickpockets.
checks.skill.checks.insight.use: In this mod: your passive Insight marks mobs that are after you and warns you when a creeper starts to hiss; villagers and piglins use theirs to see through your lies.
checks.skill.checks.performance.use: In this mod: play a note block or blow a goat horn to win over villagers and piglins nearby.
checks.skill.checks.religion.use: In this mod: better prices from clerics, and the first time you see an undead creature, a vex or a ghast up close, Religion recalls its weakness.
checks.skill.checks.history.use: In this mod: better prices from librarians and cartographers, and the first time you enter a kind of structure or meet a villager or wandering trader, History recalls what you know.
checks.skill.checks.investigation.use: In this mod: sneak and use a loot chest that has already been opened to search it once more; make it and you find one more item from its loot.
checks.skill.checks.nature.use: In this mod: the first time you see a beast or other creature of the wild up close, Nature recalls a weakness or habit of theirs.
checks.skill.checks.arcana.use: In this mod: the first time you see a magical or otherworldly creature up close, like a blaze or an enderman, Arcana recalls its weakness.
checks.skill.checks.animal_handling.use: In this mod: each attempt to tame a wolf, cat, parrot, horse, donkey, mule or llama rolls Animal Handling; make it and the animal is yours.
checks.skill.checks.survival.use: In this mod: a positive Survival modifier makes your hunger drain slower.
checks.skill.checks.medicine.use: In this mod: a positive Medicine modifier makes poison, wither, hunger and nausea wear off sooner.
Your pitch is now required reading at the lectern. Prices soar.
You offered %1$s dirt. As payment. The village heard.
Your pitch is now a village legend. Legends cost extra.
You call %1$s "Mom." The whole village heard. Big markup.
Hrmm, hrmm, hrmm: that's the whole village, repeating your pitch.
Even the chickens heard your offer. Prices skyrocket.
You call the llamas "cute goats." Prices double.
Mid-pitch, %1$s reaches for an invisibility potion.
You haggle over one sapling. Loudly. The markup is legendary.
You insult the llamas. The prices take it personally.
"Overpriced?" you ask. It is now. Very.

checks.social.persuade.failure.2: A raised eyebrow from %1$s, then a raised price.
checks.social.persuade.failure.3: You lost %1$s at "Hey, friend." Prices tick up.
checks.social.persuade.failure.4: You've been added to the "charge a bit extra" list.
checks.social.persuade.failure.5: Your charm misses. The markup doesn't.
checks.social.persuade.failure.6: You flash your best smile, and %1$s adds a smile tax.
Heard it in six biomes, says %1$s. Prices up.
A weary sigh from %1$s, then a road tax.
Your pitch walks a long way to say nothing. Prices tick up.
The llamas sneer. The prices follow their lead.
Nice try. The markup is for the walk over here.
checks.social.persuade.barely.1: A discount so small you'd need a spyglass to see it.
checks.social.persuade.barely.2: "Fine. One emerald off. Don't tell the librarian."
checks.social.persuade.barely.3: After a long "Hrmm...", %1$s shaves off a sliver.
checks.social.persuade.barely.4: That pitch should not have worked. Small discount anyway.
checks.social.persuade.barely.5: Just enough. A small discount, and absolutely no applause.
checks.social.persuade.barely.6: You win. Barely. The discount is fun-sized.
"Fine. I vanish at dusk anyway." A small discount.
One emerald off, and the llamas saw everything.
Too tired to argue, %1$s knocks a little off.
A kelp-sized discount. Take it before it wilts.
You win by a llama's whisker. Small discount.

checks.social.persuade.success.3: You nod, %1$s nods, and the prices nod downward.
checks.social.persuade.success.4: You prepared a whole speech. One line did it. Price cut.
checks.social.persuade.success.5: Kind words melt %1$s like ice by a torch. Discount!

You out-haggle a professional haggler. Good discount.
Fair words, fair price, for once on this road.
An iron golem offers you a poppy. Prices hit bedrock.
Treated like a Hero of the Village, and you didn't even stop a raid.
You don't haggle. You perform. Prices crater.
You leave with a huge discount and a fan club.
The bell rings, and for once it's good news: you. Prices plummet.
"For you," says %1$s, "the friend price."
The llamas approve of you. That never happens. Prices crash.
Saplings, kelp, potions: practically free. For you.
You've made a merchant cry. Happy tears. Huge discount.
Even the overpriced plants are cheap now. Legendary haggle.

checks.social.deceive.critical_failure.2: You claim to be the mayor. There is no mayor. Village meeting!
checks.social.deceive.critical_failure.3: Your fake mustache falls off. Everyone saw. Prices soar.
checks.social.deceive.critical_failure.4: You sign your alias with your real name. An expensive village joke.

checks.lore.minecraft.zombie: Zombies are undead: Smite cuts them down, and daylight burns any without a helmet.
checks.lore.minecraft.husk: Husks never burn in daylight, and their touch leaves you hungry. Smite still works on them.
checks.lore.minecraft.drowned: Drowned are undead that swim fast, and some throw tridents. Smite works on them.
checks.lore.minecraft.zombie_villager: A zombie villager can be cured: splash it with Weakness, then feed it a golden apple.
checks.lore.minecraft.zombified_piglin: Strike one zombified piglin and every one nearby comes for you. Gold won't calm them.
checks.lore.minecraft.zoglin: Zoglins attack anything near them, and unlike hoglins they don't fear warped fungus.
checks.lore.minecraft.zombie_horse: A zombie horse is undead: healing hurts it, and harming heals it.
checks.lore.minecraft.skeleton: Skeletons are undead archers: close in fast, or bring Smite. They run from wolves.
checks.lore.minecraft.stray: Strays shoot arrows of Slowness. They are undead, so Smite works well.
checks.lore.minecraft.bogged: The bogged shoot poison arrows. Smite hits them hard, and shears take their mushrooms.
checks.lore.minecraft.wither_skeleton: Each hit from a wither skeleton withers you. Smite helps, and some drop their skull.
checks.lore.minecraft.skeleton_horse: A skeleton horse standing in a storm may be a trap: get close and lightning brings riders.
checks.lore.minecraft.wither: The Wither is undead, so Smite helps. Below half health, arrows can't touch it.
checks.lore.minecraft.phantom: Phantoms hunt those who haven't slept in days. They are undead, and cats scare them off.
checks.lore.minecraft.vex: Vexes fly through walls and wither away in time. Kill the evoker that summons them.
checks.lore.minecraft.ghast: Hit a ghast's fireball back at it to bring it down.
checks.lore.minecraft.blaze: Blazes shrug off fire, but snowballs and water hurt them.
checks.lore.minecraft.breeze: Breezes knock arrows and other projectiles aside. Fight them up close.
checks.lore.minecraft.elder_guardian: Elder guardians curse you with Mining Fatigue. Three guard every ocean monument.
checks.lore.minecraft.guardian: A guardian charges its beam before it fires: break line of sight. Its spikes hurt when out.
checks.lore.minecraft.ender_dragon: The ender dragon heals from the crystals atop the obsidian pillars. Break those first.
checks.lore.minecraft.enderman: Don't meet an enderman's gaze unless you wear a carved pumpkin. Water hurts them, and arrows miss.
checks.lore.minecraft.endermite: Endermites sometimes crawl out where an ender pearl lands, and endermen hate them.
checks.lore.minecraft.evoker: Evokers summon vexes and biting fangs. Kill them quickly; they carry a Totem of Undying.
checks.lore.minecraft.illusioner: Illusioners blind you and fill the air with copies of themselves.
checks.lore.minecraft.iron_golem: Iron golems guard villages and hit hard. An iron ingot patches one up.
checks.lore.minecraft.magma_cube: Magma cubes split when killed, and neither fire nor falls can hurt them.
checks.lore.minecraft.slime: Slimes split into smaller slimes when killed. The smallest can't hurt you.
checks.lore.minecraft.shulker: A shulker's bullet makes you float. Hit it while its shell is open.
checks.lore.minecraft.warden: The warden is blind and finds you by sound and smell. Sneak, and throw things to lead it off.
checks.lore.minecraft.witch: Witches drink potions to heal and throw poison. Hit hard and fast.
checks.lore.minecraft.bee: A bee dies after it stings. A campfire under the hive keeps the bees calm when you harvest.
checks.lore.minecraft.cave_spider: Cave spider bites are poisonous. Bane of Arthropods hits them hard.
checks.lore.minecraft.creeper: Creepers hiss before they blow: hit and step back. Cats and ocelots scare them off.
checks.lore.minecraft.dolphin: Feed a dolphin raw fish and it leads you to treasure. Swimming with dolphins makes you faster.
checks.lore.minecraft.goat: Goats ram anything that stands still near them. Mind your footing on cliffs.
checks.lore.minecraft.hoglin: Hoglins fear warped fungus, nether portals and respawn anchors.
checks.lore.minecraft.llama: Llamas spit when angered. Lead one and others follow it in a caravan.
checks.lore.minecraft.trader_llama: Trader llamas defend their wandering trader, spitting at anything that attacks him.
checks.lore.minecraft.panda: Every panda has a temper of its own. An aggressive one strikes back if you hit it.
checks.lore.minecraft.piglin: Piglins leave you be while you wear any gold armor, and they trade for gold ingots.
checks.lore.minecraft.piglin_brute: Piglin brutes guard bastions. Gold means nothing to them, and they never give up a chase.
checks.lore.minecraft.pillager: Pillagers fire crossbows. The one carrying a banner drops an ominous bottle.
checks.lore.minecraft.polar_bear: Polar bears leave you alone unless you come near their cubs.
checks.lore.minecraft.ravager: Ravagers trample everything. Block their charge with a shield and they're stunned for a moment.
checks.lore.minecraft.silverfish: Silverfish hide in stone. Hurt one and its kin burst from the walls.
checks.lore.minecraft.spider: Spiders climb walls and stay calm in bright light. Bane of Arthropods hits them hard.
checks.lore.minecraft.vindicator: Vindicators swing axes that can knock your shield aside. Keep your distance.
checks.lore.minecraft.wolf: Hit one wolf and its whole pack turns on you. A calm one can be tamed with bones.
checks.lore.structure.village: Villages keep an iron golem on watch. Ring the bell and the villagers run for their homes.
checks.lore.structure.desert_pyramid: Under the blue terracotta at the heart of a desert pyramid, a pressure plate is wired to TNT. Dig around it.
checks.lore.structure.jungle_temple: Jungle temples hide tripwires that fire arrows, and a lever puzzle that opens a secret chest.
checks.lore.structure.ocean_monument: Eight blocks of gold lie at the heart of an ocean monument, guarded by three elder guardians.
checks.lore.structure.stronghold: Strongholds hide the End portal behind a silverfish spawner, and their libraries hold enchanted books.
checks.lore.structure.mansion: Woodland mansions belong to vindicators and evokers, and some rooms hide rare loot behind fake walls.
checks.lore.structure.ancient_city: Ancient cities are the warden's home. Sculk shriekers call it: walk softly.
checks.lore.structure.trial_chambers: Trial chambers test you with spawners. Beat them for trial keys that open the vaults.
checks.lore.structure.fortress: Nether fortresses hold blaze spawners and wither skeletons, and nether wart grows by their stairs.
checks.lore.structure.bastion: Bastions are piglin strongholds. Brutes ignore your gold, and the treasure room holds the best loot.
checks.lore.structure.outpost: Pillager outposts keep captured iron golems and allays caged nearby.
checks.lore.structure.ruined_portal: A ruined portal can be rebuilt with obsidian, and its chest often holds gold.
checks.lore.structure.shipwreck: A shipwreck carries up to three chests: supplies, treasure, and maps to buried treasure.
checks.lore.structure.mineshaft: Abandoned mineshafts hide cave spider spawners in cobwebbed corridors, and chests in minecarts.
checks.lore.structure.trail_ruins: Trail ruins lie buried. Brush the suspicious gravel to dig up pottery sherds.
checks.lore.structure.igloo: Some igloos hide a trapdoor under the carpet, down to a basement with a zombie villager and a cleric.
checks.lore.structure.unknown: You recall old stories about places like this.

checks.lore.minecraft.allay: Allays fetch items that match the one you hand them, and dance to a playing jukebox.
checks.lore.minecraft.armadillo: Armadillos curl up when threatened. Brush one for scutes to make wolf armor.
checks.lore.minecraft.axolotl: Axolotls hunt drowned and guardians alongside you, and play dead to heal.
checks.lore.minecraft.bat: Bats roost in dark caves. They're harmless, just startling.
checks.lore.minecraft.camel: Camels carry two riders, dash in bursts, and lift you out of most mobs' reach.
checks.lore.minecraft.cat: Cats scare off creepers and phantoms, and a tamed one may bring you a gift at dawn.
checks.lore.minecraft.chicken: Chickens lay eggs and flap down gently: no fall can hurt them.
checks.lore.minecraft.cod: Cod swim in schools in cool oceans. Feed them to a dolphin and it leads you to treasure.
checks.lore.minecraft.cow: Milk a cow with a bucket. Drinking the milk clears every effect on you.
checks.lore.minecraft.donkey: A tamed donkey can carry a chest. Golden carrots and apples make them breed.
checks.lore.minecraft.fox: Foxes sleep by day, hunt chickens by night, and run off with items you drop.
checks.lore.minecraft.frog: Frogs eat small slimes, and one that eats a small magma cube leaves a froglight.
checks.lore.minecraft.giant: A giant is a zombie grown huge. Smite works on it, if you ever meet one.
checks.lore.minecraft.glow_squid: Glow squid drop glow ink sacs, which make the text on a sign shine.
checks.lore.minecraft.horse: Ride a horse until it accepts you to tame it. Golden carrots heal it and make it breed.
checks.lore.minecraft.mooshroom: Shear a mooshroom for mushrooms, or milk it with a bowl for stew. Lightning changes its color.
checks.lore.minecraft.mule: Mules carry a chest like donkeys do, but can't breed.
checks.lore.minecraft.ocelot: Ocelots are shy: hold out raw fish, keep still, and they learn to trust you. Creepers fear them.
checks.lore.minecraft.parrot: Parrots mimic the hostile mobs nearby. Never feed one a cookie.
checks.lore.minecraft.pig: Saddle a pig and steer it with a carrot on a stick. Lightning turns it into a zombified piglin.
checks.lore.minecraft.pufferfish: Pufferfish puff up and poison anything close. Eating one is a bad idea.
checks.lore.minecraft.rabbit: Rabbits raid carrot farms. A rabbit's foot brews potions of Leaping.
checks.lore.minecraft.salmon: Salmon school in rivers and cold oceans, and leap from the water now and then.
checks.lore.minecraft.sheep: Shear a sheep for wool; it grows back once the sheep grazes. Dye it for colored wool.
checks.lore.minecraft.sniffer: Sniffers dig up ancient seeds that grow torchflowers and pitcher plants.
checks.lore.minecraft.snow_golem: Snow golems throw snowballs at hostile mobs, and melt in rain or hot places.
checks.lore.minecraft.squid: Squid squirt ink when hurt and drop ink sacs.
checks.lore.minecraft.strider: Striders walk on lava. Saddle one and steer it with warped fungus on a stick.
checks.lore.minecraft.tadpole: Tadpoles grow into frogs, colored by the climate they grow up in.
checks.lore.minecraft.tropical_fish: Tropical fish come in thousands of patterns, and axolotls love to hunt them.
checks.lore.minecraft.turtle: Turtles always swim home to the beach where they hatched. Their scutes make a helmet.
checks.lore.minecraft.villager: Villagers trade by profession. Cure a zombie villager for good prices, and guard them in a raid.
checks.lore.minecraft.wandering_trader: Wandering traders come and go with two llamas, and drink invisibility at night.
